scope: Randomized variants of twelve requests that carry Iceblade Hacker (13952) or Warblade of Caer Darrow (13982), whose Frost hit Go registers with shared.NewProcDamageEffect and the melee defense type (validation/2026-10-08-melee-weapon-damage-procs-sweep/*.base.json): the six new fixtures (a Survival Hunter and a Warrior with Iceblade Hacker in the main hand, an Arms Warrior with Warblade, a Warrior with Warblade in the off hand and in both hands, and an Enhancement Shaman dual wielding with Iceblade Hacker) and production builds of the other classes that wield them: a Retribution Paladin with Warblade, a Protection Paladin and a Protection Warrior tanking the boss with Iceblade Hacker, a Combat Rogue with Iceblade Hacker, a Marksmanship Hunter with Warblade and a Warrior against 5 targets with Iceblade Hacker. 16 variants of each within melee range at 200 iterations, and 8 more of each Hunter at any distance, each exported with the pinned Go engine and run by Go and Rust. Each variant draws its race from the races of its class. Warblade is a two-hander and Iceblade Hacker a main hand weapon, so the off hand and both hand placements are synthetic: Go slots them there, though the client never would.
generator: python3 tools/sweep.py validation/2026-10-08-melee-weapon-damage-procs-sweep/NAME.base.json --seed 20261008 --count 16 --iterations 200 --max-distance 5 --races RACES --output <scratch>/NAME-near, and --seed 20261009 --count 8 without --max-distance into <scratch>/NAME-far for the two Hunter bases, with RACES the class's races: Human, Dwarf, Orc, Undead, Troll, Tauren, Night Elf and Gnome for the Warriors, Dwarf, Night Elf, Orc, Tauren and Troll for the Hunters, Orc, Tauren and Troll for the Shaman, Human and Dwarf for the Paladins and Human, Dwarf, Night Elf, Orc, Undead, Troll and Gnome for the Rogue; each variant <scratch>/NAME-near/sweep-XX.json is compared as variants/NAME-near-sweep-XX.request.json

criteria.comparison: full RaidSimResult except elapsedNs, lists keyed by ID
criteria.deviations: as variances at the scale of mean^2

notes: Every variant matches the pinned Go engine on the whole result and the first-fight log, with the weapon proc landing hits, crits, partial resists, dodges and misses in the variants that keep the weapon.

The variants lower talents, drop buffs, debuffs, consumables and gear (a weapon too, in about a fifth of them) and change the target level, distance, reaction time and random stream mode. 163 of the 208 first-fight logs hold a hit of the weapon's Frost spell.
